critical_code_review_comments: student.py join_classroom uses classroom_code.upper() but join_codes stored in DB might be case-sensitive; recommend normalising both sides. In test we inserted an uppercase code to avoid this. demo_classroom_1 currently has NO join_code set in DB, so the join-classroom flow will always 404 for real users on that specific classroom until a code is provisioned. Not a regression from this feature but worth noting for demo/seed data.
